ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-15-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Petitioner: Tevea K. Him present in pro per for the minor: Lyla Khemary Phaengdy, was sworn and examined.
Application to Dispense with Notice filed.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Lyla Khemary Him.
Decree signed in open court.
